metric_definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant result over evidence-positive cases; no-evidence and uncertain cases excluded.
metric_definitions.precision_at_5: Relevant results in the returned ranking divided by 5; unavailable slots count as non-relevant.
metric_definitions.recall_at_5: Distinct labelled locations retrieved in top 5 divided by labelled relevant locations; no-evidence and uncertain cases excluded.
metric_definitions.uncertain_cases: Reported per-case but excluded from aggregate relevance metrics.
